note: An example, not a recommendation. Every number in this file is an illustration picked to show the shape, not a tested or suggested limit: choose your own for your disk, your members and your link. The server has no defaults, so every limit shown is required. Ids come from `sunbird mint-id`, token_sha256 from `sunbird mint-token`; the tokens behind these hashes were thrown away. List a proxy in trusted_proxies only if it sits in front of the server and appends the client address to X-Forwarded-For; with none listed the header is ignored.
